Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses

name: Rebecca and the Sword of Nasty Curses
storyline:
The female warrior Rebecca is the strongest warrior in this small border village. Rebecca is not only powerful with swordsmanship but also very kind-hearted. She plays a role similar to the village guardian and is deeply trusted by the villagers.

One day, Rebecca's village was attacked by a group of bandits. Almost all the villagers were kidnapped, including Takezo, the person of her unrequited love. So Rebecca embarked on a journey, vowing to defeat the bandits and save the villagers. In a new continent, Rebecca obtained the magic sword "Cursed Sword". And this magic sword will greatly change her destiny...!?

When the bandits are defeated and Rebecca successfully takes back her sweetheart, what will happen to the strongest female warrior in the village?
summary: One day, Rebecca's village is attacked by a group of thieves. Most of the villagers are taken, including her crush, Takezo. Swearing to defeat the thieves, Rebecca sets out on a journey. What fate awaits the village's strongest female warrior when she rescues her beloved?
